This meets the working count but does not establish a complete most-used top 20. The Conan Center Index recipe-name search saved all 11 alphabetically matched hits from the three listed substrings (100-result ceiling per query); this is not a usage-ranked registry search and misses candidates outside these names or Conan Center. The control covers one non-interlaced 8-bit RGBA PNG only. WG14's C standard library documents no PNG-specific parser; generic stdio reads do not qualify. No malformed-input, vulnerability or resource-use experiments were run.
